data.name: चौकीदार
data.long_meaning: The name चौकीदार is recorded with the meaning “Guardian of the fort”. चौकीदार is a Sanskrit name meaning “Guardian of the fort”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: शौकिनीकर्ता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who serves Shaukini, a goddess, or the goddess of wealth and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: चौकीदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who looks after chaukis (watches) or the one who manages the chaukis (booths, stalls, or shops).

in_tamil.name: சௌகியதார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who looks after or manages caukis (shops, stalls, or establishments).

in_telugu.name: శౌకిదార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who looks after or manages śaukis (shops, stalls, or establishments).

in_marathi.name: चौकीदार
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Guardian of the fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: चौकीदार हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name चौकीदार is derived from Sanskrit words ‘चौकी’ (fort) and ‘दार’ (doorkeeper). The name refers to a person who guards or protects a fort or a town.

in_bengali.name: चौकीदार
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Guardian of the fort
in_bengali.long_meaning: चौकीदार একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name चौकीदार is derived from Sanskrit words ‘चौकी’ (fort) and ‘दार’ (doorkeeper). The name refers to a person who guards or protects a fort or a town.
